title: चतुश्चत्वारिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 44 · The root of all duty: marriage

summary.en: Yudhishthira asks what is the root of all dharma, of offspring and of the household, and who may take a maiden's hand. Bhishma gives the rules of marriage and tells how he himself won the two daughters of Kashi for Vichitravirya, and gives the rules of the right wife and how a man is to choose her.
summary.kn: ಎಲ್ಲ ಧರ್ಮ, ಸಂತಾನ, ಗೃಹಸ್ಥಾಶ್ರಮದ ಮೂಲ ಯಾವುದು, ಕನ್ಯೆಯ ಕೈ ಹಿಡಿಯಲು ಯಾರು ಅರ್ಹರೆಂದು ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರ ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಭೀಷ್ಮ ವಿವಾಹ ನಿಯಮ, ವಿಚಿತ್ರವೀರ್ಯನಿಗಾಗಿ ತಾನು ಕಾಶಿಯ ಇಬ್ಬರು ಕನ್ಯೆಯರನ್ನು ಗೆದ್ದ ಕಥೆ, ಯೋಗ್ಯ ಪತ್ನಿಯ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: युधिष्ठिर पूछते हैं कि सब धर्म, सन्तान और गृहस्थी की जड़ क्या है और कन्या का पाणिग्रहण कौन करे। भीष्म विवाह के नियम बताते हैं, विचित्रवीर्य के लिए काशी की दो कन्याओं को जीतने की अपनी कथा कहते हैं और योग्य पत्नी के चयन के नियम देते हैं।
summary.te: అన్ని ధర్మాలు, సంతానం, గృహానికి మూలం ఏమిటి, కన్య చేయి పట్టుకోవడానికి ఎవరు అర్హులని యుధిష్ఠిరుడు అడుగుతాడు. భీష్ముడు వివాహ నియమాలు, విచిత్రవీర్యుని కోసం కాశీ రాకుమార్తెలిద్దరిని గెలిచిన కథ, తగిన భార్యను ఎంచుకునే నియమాలు చెబుతాడు.
summary.ta: எல்லா தர்மம், சந்ததி, இல்லறத்தின் வேர் எது, கன்னியின் கை பிடிக்கத் தகுந்தவர் யார் என்று யுதிஷ்டிரர் கேட்க, பீஷ்மர் திருமண விதிகளையும் விசித்திரவீரியனுக்காகக் காசியின் இரு இளவரசியரை வென்ற தம் கதையையும் தகுந்த மனைவியைத் தேர்வதன் விதிகளையும் கூறுகிறார்.
summary.ml: എല്ലാ ധർമ്മത്തിന്റെയും, സന്താനങ്ങളുടെയും, ഗൃഹത്തിന്റെയും മൂലം എന്താണെന്നും, കന്യകയുടെ കൈ ആർക്ക് സ്വീകരിക്കാമെന്നും യുധിഷ്ഠിരൻ ചോദിക്കുന്നു. വിവാഹനിയമങ്ങൾ ഭീഷ്മർ പറയുന്നു; വിചിത്രവീര്യനുവേണ്ടി കാശിയുടെ രണ്ടു പുത്രിമാരെ താൻ എങ്ങനെ നേടിയെന്നും അദ്ദേഹം വിവരിക്കുന്നു. നല്ല ഭാര്യയുടെ നിയമങ്ങളും, പുരുഷൻ അവളെ എങ്ങനെ തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കണമെന്നും അദ്ദേഹം നൽകുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 13.44; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Nov 03 2026

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
यन्मूलं सर्वधर्माणां प्रजनस्य गृहस्य च ।
पितृदेवातिथीनां च तन्मे ब्रूहि पितामह ॥

meaning.en: Grandfather, tell me what is the root of all duties, of procreation and of the household, and of the rites for ancestors, gods and guests.

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
अयं हि सर्वधर्माणां धर्मश्चिन्त्यतमो मतः ।
कीदृशाय प्रदेया स्यात्कन्येति वसुधाधिप ॥

meaning.en: Of all duties this is held to be the one that needs most thought: to what kind of man should a daughter be given, lord of the earth?

verses.text:
शीलवृत्ते समाज्ञाय विद्यां योनिं च कर्म च ।
अद्भिरेव प्रदातव्या कन्या गुणवते वरे ।
ब्राह्मणानां सतामेष धर्मो नित्यं युधिष्ठिर ॥

meaning.en: After examining his character and conduct, learning, family and work, the girl should be given with water to a bridegroom of good qualities. This is always the dharma of good brahmins, Yudhishthira.

verses.text:
आवाह्यमावहेदेवं यो दद्यादनुकूलतः ।
शिष्टानां क्षत्रियाणां च धर्म एष सनातनः ॥

meaning.en: One who gives her willingly to a suitor who should be invited, and who then takes her, follows this eternal dharma of cultured kshatriyas as well.

verses.text:
आत्माभिप्रेतमुत्सृज्य कन्याभिप्रेत एव यः ।
अभिप्रेता च या यस्य तस्मै देया युधिष्ठिर ।
गान्धर्वमिति तं धर्मं प्राहुर्धर्मविदो जनाः ॥

meaning.en: Setting aside his own wishes, one who wishes only what the girl wishes, and giving her to the man she wishes, Yudhishthira, is following what those who know dharma call the gandharva form.

verses.text:
धनेन बहुना क्रीत्वा संप्रलोभ्य च बान्धवान् ।
असुराणां नृपैतं वै धर्ममाहुर्मनीषिणः ॥

meaning.en: King, the wise call it the dharma of the asuras when a man buys a girl with much wealth and tempts her relatives.

verses.text:
हत्वा छित्त्वा च शीर्षाणि रुदतां रुदतीं गृहात् ।
प्रसह्य हरणं तात राक्षसं धर्मलक्षणम् ॥

meaning.en: My dear, abducting her by force from her home, killing and cutting down the heads of those who weep while she weeps, is called the rakshasa form.

verses.text:
पञ्चानां तु त्रयो धर्म्या द्वावधर्म्यौ युधिष्ठिर ।
पैशाच आसुरश्चैव न कर्तव्यौ कथंचन ॥

meaning.en: Of the five forms, Yudhishthira, three are lawful and two are unlawful. The paishacha and the asura forms are never to be practiced.

verses.text:
ब्राह्मः क्षात्रोऽथ गान्धर्व एते धर्म्या नरर्षभ ।
पृथग्वा यदि वा मिश्राः कर्तव्या नात्र संशयः ॥

meaning.en: The brahma, kshatra and gandharva forms are lawful, best of men. They are to be practiced, separately or in combination, without doubt.

verses.text:
तिस्रो भार्या ब्राह्मणस्य द्वे भार्ये क्षत्रियस्य तु ।
वैश्यः स्वजातिं विन्देत तास्वपत्यं समं भवेत् ॥

meaning.en: A brahmin may have three wives, a kshatriya two, and a vaishya should take one of his own class. Children born of these are equal.

verses.text:
ब्राह्मणी तु भवेज्ज्येष्ठा क्षत्रिया क्षत्रियस्य तु ।
रत्यर्थमपि शूद्रा स्यान्नेत्याहुरपरे जनाः ॥

meaning.en: Among a brahmin's wives the brahmin woman should be the eldest, and a kshatriya's eldest should be a kshatriya woman. Some say a shudra woman may be taken even for pleasure, others say no.

verses.text:
अपत्यजन्म शूद्रायां न प्रशंसन्ति साधवः ।
शूद्रायां जनयन्विप्रः प्रायश्चित्ती विधीयते ॥

meaning.en: The good do not approve the birth of a child to a shudra woman. A brahmin who fathers a child by a shudra woman is prescribed an expiation.

verses.text:
त्रिंशद्वर्षो दशवर्षां भार्यां विन्देत नग्निकाम् ।
एकविंशतिवर्षो वा सप्तवर्षामवाप्नुयात् ॥

meaning.en: A man of thirty should marry a ten-year-old girl who has not reached puberty, or a man of twenty-one a seven-year-old.

verses.text:
यस्यास्तु न भवेद्भ्राता पिता वा भरतर्षभ ।
नोपयच्छेत तां जातु पुत्रिकाधर्मिणी हि सा ॥

meaning.en: Bull of the Bharatas, a girl who has no brother or father should never be married, for she is bound by the rule of the appointed daughter.

verses.text:
त्रीणि वर्षाण्युदीक्षेत कन्या ऋतुमती सती ।
चतुर्थे त्वथ संप्राप्ते स्वयं भर्तारमर्जयेत् ॥

meaning.en: A girl who is of age should wait three years, and when the fourth arrives she may find a husband herself.

verses.text:
प्रजनो हीयते तस्या रतिश्च भरतर्षभ ।
अतोऽन्यथा वर्तमाना भवेद्वाच्या प्रजापतेः ॥

meaning.en: Bull of the Bharatas, her offspring and pleasure are lost by delay. One who acts otherwise would be blamed by Prajapati.

verses.text:
असपिण्डा च या मातुरसगोत्रा च या पितुः ।
इत्येतामनुगच्छेत तं धर्मं मनुरब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: One who is not a sapinda of the mother and not of the same gotra as the father: such a woman one should marry. Manu declared this dharma.

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
शुल्कमन्येन दत्तं स्याद्ददानीत्याह चापरः ।
बलादन्यः प्रभाषेत धनमन्यः प्रदर्शयेत् ॥

meaning.en: If one man has paid the bride-price, another says, I will give, another speaks by force, and another shows wealth,

verses.text:
पाणिग्रहीता त्वन्यः स्यात्कस्य कन्या पितामह ।
तत्त्वं जिज्ञासमानानां चक्षुर्भवतु नो भवान् ॥

meaning.en: and yet another has taken her hand, to whom does the girl belong, grandfather? Be our eye as we seek the truth.

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
यत्किंचित्कर्म मानुष्यं संस्थानाय प्रकृष्यते ।
मन्त्रवन्मन्त्रितं तस्य मृषावादस्तु पातकः ॥

meaning.en: Whatever human rite is performed for its stability, is performed with mantras and counsel, and falsehood in it is a sin.

verses.text:
भार्यापत्यृत्विगाचार्याः शिष्योपाध्याय एव च ।
मृषोक्ते दण्डमर्हन्ति नेत्याहुरपरे जनाः ॥

meaning.en: Wife, husband, officiating priest, teacher, pupil and instructor deserve punishment when they speak falsely. Others say no.

verses.text:
न ह्यकामेन संवादं मनुरेवं प्रशंसति ।
अयशस्यमधर्म्यं च यन्मृषा धर्मकोपनम् ॥

meaning.en: Manu does not approve of agreement made against one's wish. A falsehood is disgraceful, against dharma, and disturbs dharma.

verses.text:
नैकान्तदोष एकस्मिंस्तद्दानं नोपलभ्यते ।
धर्मतो यां प्रयच्छन्ति यां च क्रीणन्ति भारत ॥

meaning.en: Where there is not wholly a fault on one side, the gift is not found valid. Bharata, whether they give a girl by dharma or buy her,

verses.text:
बन्धुभिः समनुज्ञातो मन्त्रहोमौ प्रयोजयेत् ।
तथा सिध्यन्ति ते मन्त्रा नादत्तायाः कथंचन ॥

meaning.en: one should perform the mantras and the offering with the permission of relatives. The mantras succeed in no way for a girl not given.

verses.text:
यस्त्वत्र मन्त्रसमयो भार्यापत्योर्मिथः कृतः ।
तमेवाहुर्गरीयांसं यश्चासौ ज्ञातिभिः कृतः ॥

meaning.en: The agreement by mantra made here between wife and husband, and also that made by relatives, they call the weightier.

verses.text:
देवदत्तां पतिर्भार्यां वेत्ति धर्मस्य शासनात् ।
सा दैवीं मानुषीं वाचमनृतां पर्युदस्यति ॥

meaning.en: By the injunction of dharma a husband knows his wife as given by the gods. She rejects an untrue human word, whether divine or human.

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
कन्यायां प्राप्तशुल्कायां ज्यायांश्चेदाव्रजेद्वरः ।
धर्मकामार्थसंपन्नो वाच्यमत्रानृतं न वा ॥

meaning.en: When a girl has been paid for, if a better suitor comes, endowed with dharma, desire and wealth, is a falsehood to be spoken here or not?

verses.text:
तस्मिन्नुभयतो दोषे कुर्वञ्छ्रेयः समाचरेत् ।
अयं नः सर्वधर्माणां धर्मश्चिन्त्यतमो मतः ॥

meaning.en: In that case, since there is fault either way, one should do what is better. This is held to be the duty that needs the most thought of all duties.

verses.text:
तत्त्वं जिज्ञासमानानां चक्षुर्भवतु नो भवान् ।
तदेतत्सर्वमाचक्ष्व न हि तृप्यामि कथ्यताम् ॥

meaning.en: Be our eye as we seek the truth. Tell all this, for I am not satisfied with hearing it.

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच

meaning.en: Bhishma said:

verses.text:
न वै निष्ठाकरं शुल्कं ज्ञात्वासीत्तेन नाहृतम् ।
न हि शुल्कपराः सन्तः कन्यां ददति कर्हिचित् ॥

meaning.en: A bride-price does not settle the matter, so knowing this one should not take her by it. For the good never give a girl chiefly for a price.

verses.text:
अन्यैर्गुणैरुपेतं तु शुल्कं याचन्ति बान्धवाः ।
अलंकृत्वा वहस्वेति यो दद्यादनुकूलतः ॥

meaning.en: Relatives ask a bride-price from a man who has other qualities. He who gives her willingly, saying, Adorn her and take her away,

verses.text:
तच्च तां च ददात्येव न शुल्कं विक्रयो न सः ।
प्रतिगृह्य भवेद्देयमेष धर्मः सनातनः ॥

meaning.en: gives both it and her; that is not a bride-price, and not a sale. After accepting, it should be given back. This is the eternal dharma.

verses.text:
दास्यामि भवते कन्यामिति पूर्वं नभाषितम् ।
ये चैवाहुर्ये च नाहुर्ये चावश्यं वदन्त्युत ॥

meaning.en: I will give the girl to you was not said earlier, whether by those who say it, those who do not, or those who certainly speak it.

verses.text:
तस्मादा ग्रहणात्पाणेर्याचयन्ति परस्परम् ।
कन्यावरः पुरा दत्तो मरुद्भिरिति नः श्रुतम् ॥

meaning.en: Therefore they ask each other until the taking of the hand. We have heard that Maruts gave a girl and a suitor in former times.

verses.text:
नानिष्टाय प्रदातव्या कन्या इत्यृषिचोदितम् ।
तन्मूलं काममूलस्य प्रजनस्येति मे मतिः ॥

meaning.en: A girl should not be given to one who is not wished for, so the sages teach. That is the root of procreation, whose root is desire, I think.

verses.text:
समीक्ष्य च बहून्दोषान्संवासाद्विद्विषाणयोः ।
यथा निष्ठाकरं शुल्कं न जात्वासीत्तथा शृणु ॥

meaning.en: Having considered many faults arising from the living together of two who hate each other, listen how a bride-price never settles things.

verses.text:
अहं विचित्रवीर्याय द्वे कन्ये समुदावहम् ।
जित्वा च मागधान्सर्वान्काशीनथ च कोसलान् ।
गृहीतपाणिरेकासीत्प्राप्तशुल्कापराभवत् ॥

meaning.en: I took two girls to wed Vichitravirya, having defeated all the Magadhas, Kashis and Kosalas. One of them, whose hand had been taken, was one for whom the price had been paid, and she turned against it.

verses.text:
पाणौ गृहीता तत्रैव विसृज्या इति मे पिता ।
अब्रवीदितरां कन्यामावहत्स तु कौरवः ॥

meaning.en: My father said, She whose hand was taken there is to be released, and that Kaurava married the other girl.

verses.text:
अप्यन्यामनुपप्रच्छ शङ्कमानः पितुर्वचः ।
अतीव ह्यस्य धर्मेप्सा पितुर्मेऽभ्यधिकाभवत् ॥

meaning.en: Doubting his father's word, he asked about the other girl too. My father's wish for dharma was extremely great.

verses.text:
ततोऽहमब्रुवं राजन्नाचारेप्सुरिदं वचः ।
आचारं तत्त्वतो वेत्तुमिच्छामीति पुनः पुनः ॥

meaning.en: Then, king, wanting to know proper conduct, I said these words again and again: I wish to know the right practice truly.

verses.text:
ततो मयैवमुक्ते तु वाक्ये धर्मभृतां वरः ।
पिता मम महाराज बाह्लीको वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: When I had spoken thus, my father Bahlika, best of upholders of dharma, great king, spoke these words:

verses.text:
यदि वः शुल्कतो निष्ठा न पाणिग्रहणं तथा ।
लाजान्तरमुपासीत प्राप्तशुल्का पतिं वृतम् ॥

meaning.en: If your settlement is by bride-price and not by the taking of hand, then she for whom the price was paid should serve a husband chosen after the parched grain rite.

verses.text:
न हि धर्मविदः प्राहुः प्रमाणं वाक्यतः स्मृतम् ।
येषां वै शुल्कतो निष्ठा न पाणिग्रहणात्तथा ॥

meaning.en: Those who know dharma do not call a spoken word valid proof when the settlement is by bride-price and not by taking the hand.

verses.text:
प्रसिद्धं भाषितं दाने तेषां प्रत्यसनं पुनः ।
ये मन्यन्ते क्रयं शुल्कं न ते धर्मविदो जनाः ॥

meaning.en: What they say about giving is known, but it is in the end undone. Those who regard a bride-price as a purchase are not men who know dharma.

verses.text:
न चैतेभ्यः प्रदातव्या न वोढव्या तथाविधा ।
न ह्येव भार्या क्रेतव्या न विक्रेया कथंचन ॥

meaning.en: A girl is not to be given to such men, nor is such a girl to be taken. A wife is never to be bought, nor sold in any way.

verses.text:
ये च क्रीणन्ति दासीवद्ये च विक्रीणते जनाः ।
भवेत्तेषां तथा निष्ठा लुब्धानां पापचेतसाम् ॥

meaning.en: Those who buy like a maidservant and those who sell, greedy and sinful-minded, might settle it thus.

verses.text:
अस्मिन्धर्मे सत्यवन्तं पर्यपृच्छन्त वै जनाः ।
कन्यायाः प्राप्तशुल्कायाः शुल्कदः प्रशमं गतः ॥

meaning.en: On this dharma, people asked Satyavan: When a girl's bride-price had been paid, the payer became calm.

verses.text:
पाणिग्रहीता चान्यः स्यादत्र नो धर्मसंशयः ।
तन्नश्छिन्धि महाप्राज्ञ त्वं हि वै प्राज्ञसंमतः ।
तत्त्वं जिज्ञासमानानां चक्षुर्भवतु नो भवान् ॥

meaning.en: Another may be the one who took her hand. Here we have a doubt about dharma. Cut it for us, greatly wise one, for you are esteemed by the wise. Be our eye as we seek the truth.

verses.text:
तानेवं ब्रुवतः सर्वान्सत्यवान्वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।
यत्रेष्टं तत्र देया स्यान्नात्र कार्या विचारणा ।
कुर्वते जीवतोऽप्येवं मृते नैवास्ति संशयः ॥

meaning.en: To all of them speaking thus Satyavan said: She should be given where it is wished. There is no need for deliberation here. They do this even when the man is alive, and when he is dead there is no doubt.

verses.text:
देवरं प्रविशेत्कन्या तप्येद्वापि महत्तपः ।
तमेवानुव्रता भूत्वा पाणिग्राहस्य नाम सा ॥

meaning.en: She may enter the husband's brother, or perform a great austerity. Devoted to him alone, she would take the name of the one who took her hand.

verses.text:
लिखन्त्येव तु केषांचिदपरेषां शनैरपि ।
इति ये संवदन्त्यत्र त एतं निश्चयं विदुः ॥

meaning.en: For some it is written down slowly, for others too. Those who say so here know this to be the settlement.

verses.text:
तत्पाणिग्रहणात्पूर्वमुत्तरं यत्र वर्तते ।
सर्वमङ्गलमन्त्रं वै मृषावादस्तु पातकः ॥

meaning.en: Where the later claim arises before the taking of the hand, all the auspicious mantras apply, but falsehood is a sin.

verses.text:
पाणिग्रहणमन्त्राणां निष्ठा स्यात्सप्तमे पदे ।
पाणिग्राहस्य भार्या स्याद्यस्य चाद्भिः प्रदीयते ॥

meaning.en: The mantras of taking the hand are completed at the seventh step. She who is given with water becomes the wife of the one who takes her hand.

verses.text:
अनुकूलामनुवंशां भ्रात्रा दत्तामुपाग्निकाम् ।
परिक्रम्य यथान्यायं भार्यां विन्देद्द्विजोत्तमः ॥

meaning.en: A best of the twice-born should take as wife, after walking round the fire according to rule, a girl who is agreeable, of a suitable line, given by her brother and near the fire.
